description: This file defines the InterviewDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, providing methods to manipulate Interview entities, such as setting associated candidates, interviewers, and formatting interview dates and times.

classes.name: InterviewDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Interview entity, providing methods to set associations and retrieve formatted interview date and time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the InterviewDecorator with an Interview entity.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a CandidateVacancy to the interview by its ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate to the interview by its ID.

methods.name: setInterviewerByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Adds multiple Employee interviewers to the interview using their employee numbers.

methods.name: addInterviewer
methods.description: Adds a single Employee as an interviewer if not already present.

methods.name: removeInterviewers
methods.description: Removes all interviewers from the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the interview date formatted as a string.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the interview time formatted as a string or null if not set.
